The '''Ediorung system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ediorung]].
